en.t: Roman consul Agrippa Menenius Lanatus celebrates a triumph for a military victory over the Sabines
en.s: The consuls were the two highest elected public officials of the Roman Republic (c. 509 BC to 27 BC). Romans considered the consulship the second-highest level of the cursus honorum—an ascending sequence of public offices to which politicians aspired—after that of the censor, which was reserved for former consuls. Each year, the centuriate assembly elected two consuls to serve jointly for a one-year term.

zh.t: 罗马执政官阿格里帕·梅内尼乌斯·拉纳图斯因战胜萨宾人而举行凯旋式
zh.s: 执政官是罗马共和国（约公元前509年至公元前27年）最高的两名民选公职人员。罗马人认为，执政官职位在荣誉官职序列中位居第二，仅次于监察官；政治家以逐级担任这一系列公职为目标，而监察官一职只授予前任执政官。百人队大会每年选出两名执政官，共同任职一年。

en.s: Louis the Pious (Latin: Hludowicus Pius; French: Louis le Pieux; German: Ludwig der Fromme; 778 – 20 June 840), also called the Fair and the Debonaire, was King of the Franks and co-emperor with his father, Charlemagne, from 813. He was also King of Aquitaine from 781. As the only surviving son of Charlemagne and Hildegard, he became the sole ruler of the Franks after his father's death in 814.

zh.t: 虔诚者路易围城数月后从摩尔人手中夺回巴塞罗那
zh.s: 虔诚者路易（拉丁语：Hludowicus Pius；法语：Louis le Pieux；德语：Ludwig der Fromme；778年—840年6月20日），又称英俊者和温和者，自813年起担任法兰克国王，并与其父查理曼共治皇帝。他还于781年起担任阿基坦国王。作为查理曼和希尔德加德唯一存活的儿子，他在父亲814年去世后成为法兰克人的唯一统治者。

en.s: In 1268, the Byzantine Empire and the Republic of Venice agreed to temporarily end hostilities which had erupted after the Byzantine recovery of Constantinople by Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos in 1261. en.t: Queen Elizabeth I knighted Francis Drake for completing a circumnavigation of the world
en.s: Sir Francis Drake (c. 1540 – 28 January 1596) was an English explorer and privateer best known for making the second circumnavigation of the world in a single expedition between 1577 and 1580 (being the first English expedition to accomplish this). He is also known for participating in the early English slaving voyages of his cousin, John Hawkins, and John Lovell.

zh.t: 伊丽莎白一世女王因弗朗西斯·德雷克完成环球航行而授予他爵士称号
zh.s: 弗朗西斯·德雷克爵士（约1540年—1596年1月28日）是英国探险家和私掠船长，以1577年至1580年间率领单次远征完成第二次环球航行而闻名；这是首次由英国远征队完成环球航行。他还参与了其表亲约翰·霍金斯和约翰·洛弗尔早期的英国奴隶贸易航行。

en.s: The Declaration of Breda (dated 4 April 1660) was a proclamation by Charles II of England in which he promised a general pardon for crimes committed during the English Civil War and the Interregnum for all those who recognised Charles as the lawful king; the retention by the current owners of property purchased during the same period; religious toleration; and the payment of arrears to members of the army, and that the army would be recommissioned into service under the crown.

zh.s: 《布雷达宣言》（日期为1660年4月4日）是英格兰国王查理二世发布的一份公告。公告承诺，对英国内战和空位期期间犯下的罪行一律赦免，前提是当事人承认查理为合法国王；允许继续保有同期购置的财产；给予宗教宽容；支付军队欠饷；并让军队重新编入王室麾下服役。

en.s: The Battle of Sideling Hill (sometimes written Sidling Hill) was an engagement in April 1756, between Pennsylvania Colonial Militia and a band of Lenape warriors who had attacked Fort McCord and taken a number of colonial settlers captive. The warriors were taking their captives back to their base at Kittanning when they were ambushed by the militia, but with the help of reinforcements, the Lenape fought off the militia and escaped.

zh.s: 西德林山战役（有时也拼作Sidling Hill）发生于1756年4月，交战双方是宾夕法尼亚殖民地民兵与一队莱纳佩族战士。此前，战士们袭击麦科德堡并俘虏了一些殖民地居民。莱纳佩人正押着俘虏返回基坦宁据点，途中遭民兵伏击；但在援军帮助下，他们击退民兵并成功脱身。

en.s: The 1781 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1781, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Independent governor William Greene won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1781年4月4日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。独立派现任州长威廉·格林因无竞争对手而连任。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: The Capture of HMS St. Fermin was a naval engagement that took place off Málaga on 4 April 1781, during the American Revolutionary War. Spanish xebecs San Antonio and San Luis captured the sloop-of-war HMS St. Fermin.

zh.s: 1781年4月4日，美国独立战争期间，西班牙的圣安东尼奥号和圣路易斯号三桅帆船，在马拉加外海俘获英国单桅战舰圣费尔明号。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Massachusetts on April 4, 1785. James Bowdoin, the former president of the Massachusetts Constitutional Convention, received more votes than any of his rivals—Thomas Cushing, the incumbent acting governor, Benjamin Lincoln, the former United States secretary of war, and Oliver Prescott, the judge of the probate court for Middlesex County—but no candidate received a majority of the votes cast.

zh.s: 1785年4月4日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。州制宪会议前主席詹姆斯·鲍登得票最多，超过现任代州长托马斯·库欣、前美国战争部长本杰明·林肯，以及米德尔塞克斯县遗嘱检验法院法官奥利弗·普雷斯科特。但没有候选人获得过半数选票。

en.s: The 1787 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was an election held on April 4, 1787, to elect the governor of Rhode Island. John Collins beat William Bradford with 72.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 1787年4月4日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。约翰·柯林斯以72.24%的得票率击败威廉·布拉德福德。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Massachusetts on April 4, 1791. John Hancock, the incumbent governor, was re-elected against scattering opposition.

zh.s: 1791年4月4日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。现任州长约翰·汉考克击败支持分散的反对者，成功连任。

en.s: The 1792 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1792, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Anti-Federalist governor Arthur Fenner won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1792年4月4日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。反联邦党现任州长阿瑟·芬纳因无竞争对手而连任。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: The Battle of Racławice (Polish: Bitwa pod Racławicami) was one of the first battles of the Kościuszko Uprising against Russia. It was fought on 4 April 1794 near the village of Racławice in Lesser Poland. The battle site is one of Poland's official national Historic Monuments (Pomnik historii), as designated on 1 May 2004. Its listing is maintained by the National Heritage Board of Poland.

zh.s: 拉茨瓦维采之战（波兰语：Bitwa pod Racławicami）是科希丘什科起义反抗俄罗斯的首批战役之一，于1794年4月4日在小波兰拉茨瓦维采村附近爆发。战场于2004年5月1日被指定为波兰官方历史古迹之一，名录由波兰国家遗产委员会维护。

en.s: The 1796 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 4. Incumbent Governor Samuel Adams was re-elected to a third term in office over Increase Sumner.

en.s: The Battle of Curapalihue (4 April 1817) fought in Chile, was a minor encounter between South American rebels and Spanish royalists, during the South American wars of independence. The result was a defeat for the royalists.

zh.s: 1817年4月4日，南美独立战争期间，南美起义军与西班牙保王军在智利库拉帕利韦发生一场小规模战斗，最终保王军战败。

en.s: The Second Continental Congress (1775–1781) was the meeting of delegates from the Thirteen Colonies that united in support of the American Revolution and Revolutionary War, which established American independence from Great Britain. The Congress constituted a new federation that it first named the United Colonies of North America, and in 1776, renamed the United States of America.
en.n: The United States Congress, affirming the Second Continental Congress, adopts the flag of the United States with 13 red and white stripes and one star for each state (20 at that time).

zh.s: 第二次大陆会议（1775—1781年）由十三个殖民地的代表组成，团结起来支持美国革命和独立战争，最终实现美国脱离英国独立。会议建立了新的联邦，起初称为北美联合殖民地，1776年更名为美利坚合众国。
zh.n: 美国国会确认第二次大陆会议的决定，采用美国国旗：红白相间的13道条纹，以及代表当时20个州的20颗星。

Governor William Eustis died in February, leaving Lieutenant Governor Marcus Morton, a Jacksonian Republican, to fill the seat on an acting basis. In the general election, Levi Lincoln Jr., an Adams Republican, had no organized opposition.

en.s: The 1832 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1832, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent National Republican governor Lemuel H. Arnold won a plurality of the vote against former Democratic-Republican governor James Fenner and incumbent Anti-Masonic Speaker of the Rhode Island House of Representatives William Sprague III.

zh.s: 1832年4月4日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。国家共和党现任州长莱缪尔·H.阿诺德得票最多，领先民主共和党前州长詹姆斯·芬纳，以及反共济会党现任州众议院议长威廉·斯普拉格三世。

en.s: The 1836 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1836. Incumbent governor and Democratic nominee Henry W. Edwards was re-elected, defeating former governor, senator and Whig nominee Gideon Tomlinson with 53.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1836年4月4日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。民主党现任州长亨利·W.爱德华兹，以53.93%的得票率击败辉格党候选人、前州长及参议员吉迪恩·汤姆林森，成功连任。

en.t: William Henry Harrison dies of pneumonia, becoming the first President of the United States to die in office, and setting the record for the briefest administration. Vice President John Tyler succeeds Harrison as President
en.s: William Henry Harrison (February 9, 1773 – April 4, 1841) was the ninth president of the United States from March to April 1841. He died 31 days into his term, making him the shortest serving president and the first president to die in office. Immediately after his death, Vice President John Tyler took over, ending the constitutional crisis that had been triggered by the question of presidential succession in the U.S.

zh.s: 威廉·亨利·哈里森（1773年2月9日—1841年4月4日）是美国第九任总统，于1841年3月至4月在任。他在任第31天因肺炎去世，是美国在任时间最短的总统，也是首位在任内去世的总统。副总统约翰·泰勒立即继任总统，结束了由美国总统继任问题引发的宪法危机。

en.s: The 1842 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1842. Former Speaker of the Connecticut House of Representatives and Democratic nominee Chauncey Fitch Cleveland was elected, defeating incumbent governor and Whig nominee William W. Ellsworth with 49.94% of the vote. Cleveland won a plurality of the vote, but fell just short of a majority, by 107 votes.

zh.s: 1842年4月4日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前州众议院议长昌西·菲奇·克利夫兰，获得49.94%的选票，击败辉格党现任州长威廉·W.埃尔斯沃思并最终当选。克利夫兰得票最多，但距过半数还差107票。

en.s: The 1849 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1849. Incumbent Whig governor Elisha Harris did not run for re-election. Whig nominee Henry B. Anthony defeated Democratic nominee Adnah Sackett and Free Soil nominee Edward Harris.

zh.s: 1849年4月4日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。辉格党现任州长伊莱沙·哈里斯不再参选。同党候选人亨利·B.安东尼，击败民主党候选人阿德纳·萨克特和自由土地党候选人爱德华·哈里斯。

en.s: The Battle of Tápióbicske was a battle in the Spring Campaign of the Hungarian War of Independence (1848–1849), fought on 4 April 1849 between the Austrian Empire and the Hungarian Revolutionary Army. The Habsburg forces consisted of the I Corps of the Imperial Army led by Lieutenant Field Marshal Josip Jelačić. The Hungarians deployed I and III Corps led by General György Klapka and General János Damjanich respectively.

zh.s: 塔皮奥比奇凯之战是匈牙利独立战争（1848—1849年）春季攻势中的一场战斗，发生于1849年4月4日，交战双方是奥地利帝国和匈牙利革命军。约西普·耶拉契奇中将元帅指挥奥地利帝国军第一军；匈牙利军队则部署了由久尔吉·克拉普卡将军和亚诺什·达姆亚尼奇将军分别指挥的第一军和第三军。

en.s: The 1853 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1853. Incumbent governor and Democratic Party nominee Thomas H. Seymour defeated former state legislator and Whig nominee Henry Dutton and former state legislator and Free Soil nominee Francis Gillette with 51.01% of the vote. Seymour would resign on October 13, 1853, to become Minister to Russia, and Lieutenant Governor Charles H.

zh.s: 1853年4月4日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。民主党现任州长托马斯·H.西摩以51.01%的得票率，击败辉格党候选人、前州议员亨利·达顿，以及自由土地党候选人、前州议员弗朗西斯·吉列特。西摩于10月13日辞职，出任驻俄罗斯公使。原文随后提到副州长“Charles H.”，但姓名与后文在此处中断。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 4 April 1853 to elect a president for a six-year term. Incumbent president Juan Rafael Mora Porras was re-elected to a full term with 91.2% of electoral votes. According to historian Iván Molina, from this election onward and for the following four decades, electoral processes played a largely secondary role in the selection of the president, serving primarily a symbolic function of legitimization.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1853年4月4日举行大选，选出任期六年的总统。现任总统胡安·拉斐尔·莫拉·波拉斯以91.2%的选举人票，赢得一个完整任期。历史学家伊万·莫利纳认为，从这次选举起的约40年间，选举程序在总统人选的决定上大多退居次要地位，主要发挥象征性的合法化作用。

en.s: The 1855 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1855, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Whig governor William W. Hoppin won re-election against Democratic nominee Americus V. Potter.

zh.s: 1855年4月4日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。辉格党现任州长威廉·W.霍平击败民主党候选人阿梅里克斯·V.波特，成功连任。

en.s: The 1858 East Torrens colonial by-election was held on 4 April 1858 to elect one of two members for East Torrens in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member Charles Bonney resigned on 26 January 1858. John Henry Barrow won the by-election unopposed.

zh.s: 1858年4月4日，南澳大利亚州众议院举行东托伦斯选区补选，选出该选区两名议员中的一席。此次补选因现任议员查尔斯·邦尼于1858年1月26日辞职而举行。约翰·亨利·巴罗在没有对手的情况下当选。

en.s: The 1859 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1859. It was a rematch of the 1858 Connecticut gubernatorial election. Incumbent governor and Republican nominee William Alfred Buckingham defeated former congressman and Democratic nominee James T. Pratt with 51.19% of the vote.

zh.s: 1859年4月4日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举，上届两名候选人再次竞争。共和党现任州长威廉·阿尔弗雷德·白金汉，以51.19%的得票率击败民主党候选人、前国会议员詹姆斯·T.普拉特。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Rhode Island on April 4, 1860. The Democratic and Conservative candidate William Sprague IV defeated the Republican former member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives from Providence Seth Padelford. At the Republican state convention, Padelford, a Radical Republican, defeated the incumbent governor Thomas G. Turner. Padelford's nomination precipitated a movement by Conservative Republicans, former Whigs, and Democrats to jointly nominate Sprague as the conservative fusion candidate.

zh.s: 1860年4月4日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主党与保守派联合候选人威廉·斯普拉格四世，击败共和党候选人、曾代表普罗维登斯的前州众议员塞思·帕德尔福德。激进共和党人帕德尔福德此前在本党州代表大会击败现任州长托马斯·G.特纳，获得提名。此举促使保守派共和党人、前辉格党人和民主党人联合提名斯普拉格，作为保守派的共同候选人。

en.s: The 1862 Preston by-election was held on 4 April 1862, after the incumbent Conservative MP R. A. Cross resigned to enter a private banking business in Warrington. The by-election was won by the Conservative candidate, Thomas Hesketh. Hesketh was related to two previous MPs for the constituency, both also named Thomas Hesketh, one from the 16th century and one from the 18th.

zh.s: 1862年4月4日，英国普雷斯顿选区举行补选。原保守党议员R.A.克罗斯辞职，前往沃灵顿从事私人银行业务。保守党候选人托马斯·赫斯基思获胜。他与两位曾代表该选区的同名议员有亲属关系，那两人也都叫托马斯·赫斯基思，分别生活于16世纪和18世纪。

en.s: The 1864 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1864, and the first of two gubernatorial elections in which the Republicans adopted the National Union Party name, as the national party had done during the 1864 presidential election. Incumbent governor and National Union nominee William Alfred Buckingham defeated Democratic nominee Origen S. Seymour with 53.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1864年4月4日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。共和党仿照全国党组织在当年总统选举中的做法，以“全国联盟党”名称参选；该州连续两次州长选举采用此名，这是第一次。全国联盟党现任州长威廉·阿尔弗雷德·白金汉，以53.65%的得票率击败民主党候选人奥里根·S.西摩。

en.s: The 1866 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1866, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Republican nominee and former Union Army Major General Ambrose Burnside defeated Democratic nominee Lyman Pierce.

zh.s: 1866年4月4日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党候选人、前联邦军少将安布罗斯·伯恩赛德，击败民主党候选人莱曼·皮尔斯。

en.t: Alexander II of Russia narrowly escapes an assassination attempt by Dmitry Karakozov in the city of Saint Petersburg
en.s: Alexander II (29 April 1818 – 13 March 1881) was Emperor of Russia, King of Poland, and Grand Duke of Finland from 2 March 1855 until his assassination on 13 March 1881. He is also known as Alexander the Liberator because of his historic Edict of Emancipation, which officially abolished Russian serfdom in 1861. Crowned on 7 September 1856, he succeeded his father Nicholas I and was succeeded by his son Alexander III.

zh.t: 俄罗斯皇帝亚历山大二世在圣彼得堡险遭德米特里·卡拉科佐夫刺杀
zh.s: 亚历山大二世（1818年4月29日—1881年3月13日）自1855年3月2日起担任俄罗斯皇帝、波兰国王和芬兰大公，直至1881年3月13日遇刺身亡。他因颁布1861年正式废除俄国农奴制的《解放宣言》，又被称为“解放者亚历山大”。他于1856年9月7日加冕，继承其父尼古拉一世，死后由儿子亚历山大三世继位。

zh.s: 1870年4月4日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举，两大党同一对候选人连续第三次竞争。民主党候选人、前州长詹姆斯·E.英格利希，以50.48%的得票率击败共和党现任州长马歇尔·朱厄尔。

en.s: The 1883 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 4, 1883. Republican nominee Augustus O. Bourn defeated Democratic nominee William Sprague IV with 54.48% of the vote.

en.s: The 1885 FA Cup final was a football match between Blackburn Rovers and Queen's Park on 4 April 1885 at Kennington Oval in London. It was the fourteenth final of the world's oldest football competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (known in the modern era as the FA Cup). Blackburn had won the Cup in the previous season while Queen's Park were competing in their second final with the previous final being previous year.

zh.s: 1885年4月4日，布莱克本流浪者与女王公园在伦敦肯宁顿椭圆球场争夺足总杯冠军。这是世界上历史最悠久的足球赛事——英格兰足球协会挑战杯，今天称为足总杯——的第14届决赛。布莱克本是上届冠军，女王公园则连续第二年进入决赛，也是队史第二次。

en.s: General elections to the Cortes Generales were held in Spain on 4 April 1886. At stake were all 395 seats in the Congress of Deputies.

en.s: In the Chicago mayoral election of 1893, Democrat Carter Harrison III won election, returning him the mayor's office for a (then-record) fifth non-consecutive term as mayor of Chicago. en.t: Two destructive earthquakes strike Bulgaria's Kresna region
en.s: Two strong earthquakes struck the Kresna region of Bulgaria on April 4, roughly twenty minutes apart. The first shock occurred in the morning in the Struma River valley between Kresna and Krupnik; a larger shock followed. The article assigns the pair magnitudes of 6.9 and 7.2 on the surface-wave scale, and reports more than 200 deaths. Simitli and Krupnik were destroyed, while Dzhumaya, Bansko and Razlog suffered major damage. The disaster is recorded as a doublet earthquake rather than two unrelated anniversaries. Its epicentres and effects place this event in present-day southwestern Bulgaria.

zh.t: 保加利亚克雷斯纳地区接连发生两次强震
zh.s: 4月4日，保加利亚克雷斯纳地区在约20分钟内接连发生两次强震。第一次于上午发生在克雷斯纳与克鲁普尼克之间的斯特鲁马河谷，随后发生更强的第二次地震。原文给出的面波震级分别为6.9级和7.2级，并记载200多人死亡。锡米特利和克鲁普尼克被毁，朱马亚、班斯科与拉兹洛格严重受损。这场灾难被记录为一次双震事件，并非两个互不相关的纪念日。震中及受灾范围均位于今天的保加利亚西南部。

en.s: The 1905 Kangra earthquake occurred in the Kangra Valley and the Kangra district of the Himachal Pradesh, in India on 4 April 1905. The earthquake measured 7.8 on the surface-wave magnitude scale and killed more than 20,000 people. Apart from this, most buildings in the towns of Kangra, Mcleodganj and Dharamshala were destroyed. The earthquake also had a widespread impact in Jammu and Kashmir particularly in the densely populated Kashmir valley. A total of 7,000 to 8,000 people were killed in Jammu and Kashmir with 4,000 to 5,000 deaths occurring in the Kashmir valley.

zh.s: 1905年4月4日，印度今喜马偕尔邦坎格拉谷地及坎格拉地区发生地震，面波震级为7.8级，死亡人数超过两万。坎格拉、麦克劳德根杰及达兰萨拉多数建筑被毁。地震也广泛影响查谟和克什米尔，尤其是人口稠密的克什米尔谷地。查谟和克什米尔共约7000至8000人死亡，其中谷地死亡约4000至5000人。

en.s: The 1911 San Diego mayoral election was held on April 4, 1911, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent Mayor Grant Conard and James E. Wadham received the most votes in the primary election and advanced to the runoff. Wadham was then elected mayor with a majority of the votes.

en.s: The 1922 Wisconsin Supreme Court special election was a special election held on Tuesday, April 4, 1922, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a partial term. The election took place after the death of John B. Winslow. Incumbent (appointed) justice Burr W. Jones won election.

en.s: The Battle of the Segre is the collective name of a series of battles that took place along the Segre River between 4 April 1938 and 3 January 1939 during the Spanish Civil War, after the Nationalist Faction had broken the lines of the Spanish Republican Army in the Aragon Offensive. Although seldom mentioned in historical works, it was one of the most protracted battles of the Civil War.

zh.s: 塞格雷河战役是西班牙内战中一系列战斗的统称，发生于1938年4月4日至1939年1月3日的塞格雷河沿岸。此前国民军在阿拉贡攻势中突破共和国军防线。尽管历史著作较少提及，这仍是内战中持续时间最长的战役之一。

en.t: 1940 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election
en.s: The New Zealand Labour Party leadership election, 1940 was held on 4 April 1940 to choose the fourth leader of the New Zealand Labour Party. The election was won by Wellington Central MP Peter Fraser. It followed the death of incumbent Labour leader and Prime Minister Michael Joseph Savage.

zh.s: 1940年4月4日，新西兰工党举行党魁选举，选出该党第四任党魁。惠灵顿中央选区议员彼得·弗雷泽当选。此次选举是在时任工党党魁兼总理迈克尔·约瑟夫·萨维奇去世后举行的。

en.s: The action of 4 April 1941 was a naval engagement fought during the Battle of the Atlantic during the Second World War. A German commerce raider, Thor (Schiff 10 to the Kriegsmarine, Raider E to the British), encountered the British armed merchant cruiser HMS Voltaire and sank her after a short engagement. The German crew rescued the British survivors, some of whom were repatriated and gave an account to the Admiralty.

zh.s: 1941年4月4日海战是第二次世界大战大西洋战役期间发生的一场海战。德国商船袭击舰“托尔”号（德国海军编号为Schiff 10，英国代号为Raider E）遭遇英国武装商船巡洋舰“伏尔泰”号，短暂交战后将其击沉。德舰船员救起英国幸存者，其中一些人后来被遣返并向英国海军部讲述了经过。

en.s: The 1942 Copa Ibarguren was the 19th edition of a national cup of Argentina. From this edition onwards, the cup was contested by the winners of Primera División and the Copa Presidente de la Nación (a competition formed by teams from regional leagues). The final was contested by River Plate (1942 Primera División champion), and Liga Cordobesa de Fútbol ("Córdoba League"), champion of the 1942 Copa Presidente.

zh.s: 1943年4月4日，河床队在决赛中以7比0击败科尔多瓦联赛代表队，赢得1942届阿根廷伊巴古伦杯。

en.t: Bombing of Bucharest in World War II
en.s: The Bucharest World War II bombings were primarily Allied bombings of railroad targets and those of the Oil Campaign of World War II, but included a bombing by Nazi Germany after the 1944 coup d'état. Bucharest stored and distributed much of Ploiești's refined oil products. The first operation was a sequence of 17 aerial bombardments, starting with the one of April 4, 1944.

en.t: Greek judge and archeologist Panagiotis Poulitsas is appointed Prime Minister of Greece in the midst of the Greek Civil War
en.s: Panagiotis Poulitsas (Greek: Παναγιώτης Πουλίτσας; 9 September 1881 – 16 January 1968) was a Greek judge and archeologist who briefly served as interim Prime Minister of Greece from 4 April 1946 to 18 April 1946. He was born in Geraki, Laconia on 9 September 1881. As President of the Council of State, he took the premiership of an interim government from 4 to 18 April 1946 after the troubled 31 March 1946 elections, which were simultaneous with the reigniting of the Greek Civil War.

zh.t: 帕纳约蒂斯·普利察斯就任希腊总理
zh.s: 帕纳约蒂斯·普利察斯（希腊语：Παναγιώτης Πουλίτσας；1881年9月9日—1968年1月16日）是希腊法官和考古学家，曾于1946年4月4日至18日短暂担任临时总理。他出生于拉科尼亚的耶拉基。作为国务委员会主席，他在1946年3月31日选举局势混乱、希腊内战再度燃起后，出任临时政府总理。

en.t: Twelve countries sign the North Atlantic Treaty
en.s: Representatives of twelve European and North American countries signed the North Atlantic Treaty in Washington, D.C., establishing the framework for NATO. The agreement placed collective defence at the centre of a new transatlantic alliance during the early Cold War. Under Article 5, an armed attack against one member in the treaty's defined area would be considered an attack against all, with each ally taking the action it deemed necessary. The treaty also committed members to peaceful dispute resolution and consultation when their security was threatened. This anniversary marks the signing of the founding agreement, rather than a later accession or military operation.

zh.t: 十二国签署《北大西洋公约》
zh.s: 欧洲和北美十二国的代表在美国华盛顿签署《北大西洋公约》，为北约的成立奠定基础。冷战初期，这一新跨大西洋联盟以集体防御为核心。公约第五条规定，对条约所界定区域内任何成员的武装攻击，都将被视为对全体成员的攻击，各盟国将采取其认为必要的行动。成员还承诺和平解决争端，并在安全受到威胁时进行磋商。这一纪念日对应的是创始公约的签署，而非后来成员加入或军事行动的日期。

en.s: The 1950 Wisconsin Supreme Court special election was a special election held on Tuesday, April 4, 1950, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court. Incumbent justice John E. Martin (appointed in 1948 to fill the vacancy created by the death on the bench of Chester A. Fowler) won election, defeating challenger Marshall Peterson.

zh.t: 1950年威斯康星州最高法院特别选举
zh.s: 1950年4月4日星期二，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官特别选举。约翰·E.马丁于1948年获任命，填补切斯特·A.福勒任内去世留下的空缺，此次击败挑战者马歇尔·彼得森，赢得选举。

en.s: The al-Hamma Incident (Hebrew: תקרית אל-חמה) refers to an event on 4 April 1951 that resulted in the death of seven IDF soldiers at the hands of Syrian military forces. The action occurred during an Israeli attempt to enforce its claimed sovereignty over the demilitarized zone along the Syrian border.

zh.s: 哈马事件（希伯来语：תקרית אל-חמה）发生于1951年4月4日，7名以色列国防军士兵在事件中被叙利亚军队杀害。事发时，以色列正试图在叙利亚边境沿线的非军事区实施其所主张的主权。

Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

en.t: 1961 United States Senate special election in Texas
en.s: The 1961 United States Senate special election in Texas was held on May 27, 1961. The election was held to replace outgoing Senator Lyndon B. Johnson, who had been elected Vice President of the United States. Republican John Tower, who had been the nominee for the regularly scheduled election in 1960, defeated 70 other candidates to become the first Republican to represent Texas in the Senate since Reconstruction in 1877.

en.t: Bye Bye Birdie, a musical romantic comedy film directed by George Sidney, was released
en.s: Bye Bye Birdie is a 1963 American musical romantic comedy film directed by George Sidney from a screenplay by Irving Brecher, based on Michael Stewart's book of the 1960 musical of the same name. It also features songs by composer Charles Strouse and lyricist Lee Adams and a score by Johnny Green. en.s: The Thanh Hóa Bridge (Vietnamese: Cầu Hàm Rồng, Hàm Rồng Bridge), spanning the Song Ma river, is situated 3 miles (4.8 km) northeast of Thanh Hóa (), the capital of Thanh Hóa Province in Vietnam. In 1965 during the Vietnam War, it was the objective of many attacks by US Air Force and US Navy aircraft which would fail to destroy the bridge until 1972, even after hundreds of attacks.

en.t: Assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.
en.s: Martin Luther King Jr. was an American clergyman and civil rights leader who was fatally shot at the Lorraine Motel in Memphis, Tennessee, on April 4, 1968. King was rushed to St. Joseph's Hospital, where he was pronounced dead at 7:05 p.m. that evening. He was a prominent leader of the Civil Rights Movement and Nobel Peace Prize laureate who was known for his use of nonviolence and civil disobedience. James Earl Ray, a fugitive from the Missouri State Penitentiary, was arrested on June 8, 1968, in London at Heathrow Airport, extradited to the United States, and charged with the crime.

zh.s: 1968年4月4日，美国牧师、民权领袖马丁·路德·金，在田纳西州孟菲斯洛林汽车旅馆遭枪击。他被紧急送往圣约瑟夫医院，于当晚7时05分宣告死亡。金是美国民权运动的重要领袖、诺贝尔和平奖得主，以非暴力与公民抗命方式争取权利而闻名。密苏里州立监狱逃犯詹姆斯·厄尔·雷，于1968年6月8日在伦敦希思罗机场被捕，随后被引渡回美国，并被控犯下此案。

en.t: Southern Airways Flight 242 crashes in Georgia
en.s: Southern Airways Flight 242 made a forced landing on a highway near New Hope, Georgia, on April 4 after a severe thunderstorm disabled both engines. Hail damaged the aircraft as the crew tried to fly toward Atlanta, and the jet struck roadside structures during its attempted landing. Sixty-three people aboard the aircraft and nine people on the ground died; twenty-two aboard survived. The National Transportation Safety Board concluded that water and hail ingestion, combined with thrust lever movement, caused the engines' loss of power. The crash remains the deadliest aviation accident in Georgia and led to a detailed investigation of weather information and flight decisions.

zh.t: 南方航空242号班机在佐治亚州坠毁
zh.s: 4月4日，南方航空242号班机因强雷暴导致双发失效，试图在美国佐治亚州纽霍普附近一条公路迫降。机组飞往亚特兰大途中，飞机遭冰雹损坏，迫降时撞上路旁建筑。机上63人及地面九人死亡，另有22名机上人员生还。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，发动机吸入水和冰雹，加上推力手柄的操作，造成动力丧失。按原文记载，这是佐治亚州死亡人数最多的航空事故，调查人员对气象信息和飞行决策进行了详细审查。

en.t: Prime Minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto of Pakistan is executed
en.s: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto NPk HPk (5 January 1928 – 4 April 1979) was a Pakistani barrister, and statesman who served as the fourth president of Pakistan from 1971 to 1973, and as the ninth prime minister of Pakistan from 1973 until his overthrow in 1977. He was the founder and first chairman of the Pakistan People's Party (PPP) from 1967 until his execution in 1979.

zh.t: 巴基斯坦前总理布托被处决
zh.s: 1979年4月4日，巴基斯坦前总理佐勒菲卡尔·阿里·布托被处决。

en.s: The H-3 airstrike (Persian: عملیات اچ۳) was a surprise air attack by the Iranian Air Force during the Iran–Iraq War on 4 April 1981 against the Iraqi Air Force's H-3 Air Base in western Iraq. The Iranians destroyed at least 48 Iraqi aircraft on the ground with no losses of their own. Based on the results achieved, it is considered one of the most successful raids in the history of aerial warfare.

zh.s: H-3空袭（波斯语：عملیات اچ۳）是伊朗空军在两伊战争期间于1981年4月4日发动的一次突袭，目标是伊拉克西部的H-3空军基地。伊朗至少摧毁了地面上的48架伊拉克飞机，自身没有损失。根据行动成果，这被视为航空战争史上最成功的空袭之一。

en.s: STS-6 was the sixth NASA Space Shuttle mission and the maiden flight of the Space Shuttle Challenger. Launched from Kennedy Space Center on April 4, 1983, the mission deployed the first Tracking and Data Relay Satellite, TDRS-1, into orbit, before landing at Edwards Air Force Base on April 9, 1983. STS-6 was the first Space Shuttle mission during which a Extravehicular activity was conducted, and hence was the first in which the Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) was used.

zh.s: STS-6是美国国家航空航天局第六次航天飞机任务，也是“挑战者”号航天飞机的首次飞行。航天飞机于1983年4月4日从肯尼迪航天中心发射，将第一颗跟踪与数据中继卫星TDRS-1送入轨道，随后于4月9日在爱德华兹空军基地着陆。这是首次进行舱外活动的航天飞机任务，因此也是首次使用舱外机动装置（EMU）的任务。

en.s: Garuda Indonesia Flight 035 was a domestic Garuda Indonesia flight that struck a pylon and crashed on approach to Medan-Polonia Airport on 4 April 1987. Out of the 45 passengers and crew on board, 23 were killed in the accident.

zh.s: 1987年4月4日，印尼鹰航035号国内航班在飞往棉兰波洛尼亚机场进场时撞上高压电塔并坠毁。机上45名乘客和机组人员中有23人遇难。

en.s: The 1989 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 4, 1989, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Incumbent justice Shirley Abrahamson was re-elected over Ralph Adam Fine. The campaign was described to be a "heated race".

zh.t: 1989年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1989年4月4日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。现任法官雪莉·亚伯拉罕森击败拉尔夫·亚当·法恩，成功连任。这次竞选被形容为竞争激烈。

en.s: The 1989 St. Louis mayoral election was held on April 4, 1989 to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. It saw the re-election of Vincent C. Schoemehl to a third term. The election was preceded by party primaries on March 7.

zh.s: 1989年4月4日，密苏里州圣路易斯举行市长选举。文森特·C·舍梅尔连任，开始第三个任期。选举前，政党初选已于3月7日举行。

en.s: The Chicago mayoral election of 1989 saw Democratic nominee Richard M. Daley win election to the remainder of an unexpired mayoral term with a 14% margin of victory. This marked a return for the Daley family to the office of mayor. Daley was elected over Alderman Timothy Evans, the nominee of the newly formed Harold Washington Party, and the Republican nominee Ed Vrdolyak.

zh.s: 1989年4月4日，民主党候选人理查德·M.戴利在芝加哥市长特别选举中胜出，接任尚未届满的市长任期，得票领先14个百分点。戴利击败了哈罗德·华盛顿党候选人、市议员蒂莫西·埃文斯，以及共和党候选人埃德·弗德利亚克。他当选也使戴利家族重返市长职位。

en.s: The Neath by-election, 1991 was a by-election held on 4 April 1991 for the British House of Commons constituency of Neath in Wales. It was won by the Labour Party candidate Peter Hain.

zh.s: 1991年4月4日，英国威尔士尼思下议院选区举行补选，工党候选人彼得·海恩获胜。

en.t: Forty-one people are taken hostage inside a Good Guys! Electronics store in Sacramento, California. Three of the hostage takers and three hostages are killed
en.s: California is a state in the Western United States that lies on the Pacific Coast. It borders Oregon to the north, and Nevada and Arizona to the east; it also shares an international border with the Mexican state of Baja California to the south. With over 39 million residents across an area of 163,696 square miles (423,970 km2), it is the largest U.S. state by population and third-largest by area.

zh.t: 加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托的一家Good Guys!电子商店内有41人遭劫持为人质；三名劫持者和三名人质死亡
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州位于美国西部太平洋沿岸。该州北邻俄勒冈州，东接内华达州和亚利桑那州，南部与墨西哥下加利福尼亚州接壤。该州面积为163,696平方英里（423,970平方公里），居民超过3,900万，是美国人口最多、面积第三大的州。

en.s: On April 4, 1991, a Piper Aerostar propeller-driven aircraft collided in mid-air with a Bell 412 helicopter over Merion Elementary School in Lower Merion Township, a suburb west of Philadelphia, in southeast Pennsylvania. All five people in both aircraft were killed, including United States Senator John Heinz, the sole passenger of the Piper. On the ground, two schoolchildren were killed by falling debris and five people were injured.

zh.s: 1991年4月4日，一架派珀“空中之星”螺旋桨飞机在宾夕法尼亚州东南部、费城西郊下梅里恩镇上空与一架贝尔412直升机相撞。两架飞机上的五人全部遇难，其中包括派珀飞机唯一乘客、美国联邦参议员约翰·海因茨。地面上，两名学童被坠落碎片击中身亡，另有五人受伤。

en.s: WrestleMania IX was a 1993 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the ninth annual WrestleMania and took place on April 4, 1993, at Caesars Palace in Paradise, Nevada in the Las Vegas area. It was the first WrestleMania event held outdoors. WrestleMania IX was built around two main storylines.

zh.s: 第九届摔角狂热是世界摔角联盟（WWF，后来的WWE）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1993年4月4日在美国内华达州拉斯维加斯地区帕拉代斯的凯撒宫举行。这是首次在露天举办的摔角狂热，赛事围绕两条主要剧情展开。

en.s: KLM Cityhopper Flight 433 was a Saab 340B, registered as PH-KSH, which crashed during an emergency landing on 4 April 1994, resulting in the death of 3 occupants, including the captain. Flight 433 was a routine scheduled flight from Amsterdam, the Netherlands, to Cardiff, Wales, United Kingdom. The accident was caused by inadequate pilot training and a faulty sensor, leading to loss of control during go-around.

zh.t: 荷兰皇家航空城市短途航空433号班机空难
zh.s: 荷兰皇家航空城市短途航空433号班机使用注册号PH-KSH的萨博340B飞机，于1994年4月4日紧急迫降时坠毁，造成3名机上人员死亡，其中包括机长。该航班原为从荷兰阿姆斯特丹飞往英国威尔士加的夫的定期航班。事故由飞行员培训不足和传感器故障引发，导致复飞过程中失控。

en.s: Netscape Communications Corporation (originally Mosaic Communications Corporation) was an American independent computer services company with headquarters in Mountain View, California, and then Dulles, Virginia. Its Netscape web browser was once dominant but lost to Internet Explorer and other competitors in the first browser war, with its market share falling from more than 90 percent in the mid-1990s to less than one percent in 2006.

zh.s: 网景通信公司（最初名为Mosaic通信公司）是一家美国独立计算机服务公司，总部先后设在加利福尼亚州山景城和弗吉尼亚州杜勒斯。网景浏览器曾占据主导地位，但在第一次浏览器大战中输给Internet Explorer及其他竞争者，市场份额从20世纪90年代中期的90%以上降至2006年的不到1%。

en.s: The 1995 Brown County, Wisconsin Executive election took place on April 4, 1995. Incumbent County Executive Tom Cuene ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged by County Supervisor Steve Lasee. Because Cuene and Lasee were the only two candidates to file, the primary election was cancelled and the candidates proceeded to the general election.

zh.t: 1995年威斯康星州布朗县县长选举
zh.s: 1995年4月4日，美国威斯康星州布朗县举行县长选举。现任县长汤姆·奎恩寻求第三个任期，县议员史蒂夫·拉西向其挑战。由于只有两人报名，初选取消，两人直接进入正式选举。

en.s: The 1995 Wisconsin Spring Election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on April 4, 1995.

zh.s: 1995年4月4日，美国威斯康星州举行春季选举。

en.s: The 1995 Colorado Springs mayoral election took place on April 4, 1995, to elect the mayor of Colorado Springs, Colorado. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections. The election was officially nonpartisan. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Robert M. Issac to a fifth term.

zh.t: 1995年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举
zh.s: 1995年4月4日，科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯举行市长选举，并与其他多项地方选举同期进行。选举正式不设党派。现任市长罗伯特·M·艾萨克连任第五个任期。

en.s: The Chicago mayoral election of 1995 resulted in the re-election of Democratic Party nominee incumbent Richard M. Daley over independent candidate Roland Burris, with 359,466 votes to Burris's 217,024. Daley won 60.1% of the total vote, winning by a landslide 24-point margin. The Republican candidate, Raymond Wardingley, fared poorly with only 2.8% of the vote. A fourth-place candidate, Harold Washington Party nominee Lawrence Redmond, won 0.9% of the votes.

zh.s: 1995年芝加哥市长选举中，民主党提名人、现任市长理查德·M·戴利击败独立候选人罗兰·布里斯连任，戴利获得359,466票，布里斯获得217,024票。戴利得票率为60.1%，以24个百分点的巨大优势获胜。共和党候选人雷蒙德·沃德林格利得票率仅2.8%；排名第四的哈罗德·华盛顿党提名人劳伦斯·雷德蒙德获得0.9%的选票。

en.s: The CMLL International Gran Prix (1997) was a lucha libre, or professional wrestling, tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; "World Wrestling Council" in Spanish) which took place on April 4, 1997 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico, CMLL's main venue. The 1997 International Gran Prix was the fourth time CMLL has held an International Gran Prix tournament since 1994.

zh.s: 1997年CMLL国际大奖赛，是墨西哥世界摔角理事会制作并编排剧情的墨西哥职业摔角锦标赛，于4月4日在该联盟的主要场馆、墨西哥城墨西哥竞技场举行。这是CMLL自1994年开始举办国际大奖赛以来的第四届。

en.s: The 1998 Coupe de la Ligue final was a football match held at Stade de France, Saint-Denis on 4 April 1998, that saw Paris Saint-Germain defeat Bordeaux in a penalty shoot-out.

zh.s: 1998年法国联赛杯决赛于1998年4月4日在圣但尼法兰西体育场举行。巴黎圣日耳曼在点球大战中击败波尔多。

en.s: The 2000 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 4, 2000, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Incumbent justice Diane S. Sykes (who had been appointed in 1999) was re-elected, defeating challenger Louis B. Butler by a wide margin.

zh.t: 2000年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2000年4月4日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。1999年获任命的现任法官黛安·S.赛克斯，以较大优势击败挑战者路易斯·B.巴特勒，成功连任。

en.s: The 2000 Pennsylvania Democratic presidential primary took place on April 4, 2000, as one of two primaries on the same day in the Democratic primaries for the 2000 United States presidential election. The Pennsylvania primary was a closed primary, with the state awarding 191 delegates, of whom 186 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the primary results.

zh.t: 2000年宾夕法尼亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年4月4日，宾夕法尼亚州举行民主党总统初选，是当天两场民主党总统提名初选之一。这是一场仅限本党登记选民参加的封闭式初选。该州共有191名全国代表大会代表，其中186名须根据初选结果承诺支持相应候选人。

en.s: The 2000 Wisconsin Democratic presidential primary took place on April 4, 2000 as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. The Wisconsin primary was an open primary, with the state awarding 93 delegates to the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of which 77 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2000年威斯康星州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年4月4日，威斯康星州举行民主党总统初选，是当年总统选举提名程序的一部分。该州采用不要求事先登记为本党选民的开放式初选。全州共有93名民主党全国代表大会代表，其中77名须根据初选结果承诺支持相应候选人。

en.s: The 2000 Milwaukee mayoral election was held on April 4, 2000, in order to elect the mayor of Milwaukee. Incumbent mayor John Norquist was re-elected to a fourth term in office.

zh.s: 2000年4月4日，密尔沃基举行市长选举。现任市长约翰·诺奎斯特连任，开始第四个任期。

en.s: On April 4, 2000, Wisconsin held its spring election. The ballot included a contested Wisconsin Supreme Court election, presidential preference primaries for both major parties, and nonpartisan local and judicial offices.
en.n: This records the spring election, separate from the November general election.

zh.s: 2000年4月4日，威斯康星州举行春季选举。选票包括威斯康星州最高法院法官选举、两大政党的总统候选人初选，以及地方公职和其他司法职位选举。
zh.n: 此条记录春季选举，与11月的大选分开。

en.s: The 2000 Anchorage mayoral election was held on April 4 and May 2, 2000, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. It saw election of George Wuerch. Incumbent mayor Rick Mystrom was term-limited. Proposition 10, passed in 1999, required mayoral candidates to receive 50% of the votes cast in a race to avoid a runoff.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2000年4月4日和5月2日，阿拉斯加州安克雷奇举行市长选举，选出乔治·沃尔奇。现任市长里克·米斯特罗姆因任期限制不能竞选连任。1999年通过的10号提案规定，市长候选人必须获得50%的选票，才能避免第二轮投票。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的首轮投票日期。

en.s: The Angolan Civil War (Portuguese: Guerra Civil Angolana) was a civil war in Angola, beginning in 1975 and continuing, with interludes, until 2002. The war began immediately after Angola became independent from Portugal in November 1975. It was a power struggle between two former anti-colonial guerrilla movements, the communist People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA) and the anti-communist National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安哥拉内战始于1975年，期间多次停战，直到2002年结束。安哥拉于1975年11月脱离葡萄牙独立后，内战随即爆发。战争是两个前反殖民游击运动争夺权力的斗争：共产主义的安哥拉人民解放运动（MPLA）和反共的争取安哥拉彻底独立全国联盟（UNITA）。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Najaf was a major battle in the 2003 U.S. invasion of Iraq. The first stage of the battle was fought when the U.S. 3rd Infantry Division fought to surround the town. The second stage was fought when soldiers from the U.S. 101st Airborne Division fought to clear and secure the city.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 纳杰夫之战是2003年美国入侵伊拉克期间的一场重大战役。战斗第一阶段，美国第三步兵师试图包围该镇；第二阶段，美国第101空降师的士兵进入该市进行清剿并确保其安全。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Samawah took place during the 2003 invasion of Iraq as American troops fought to clear the city of Iraqi forces. The city had been bypassed during the advance on Baghdad, leaving the task of clearing it to American paratroopers of the 82nd Airborne Division with mechanized infantry and armor provided by units of the 1st Battalion, 41st Infantry Regiment, and 2-70th Armor Battalions, along with 3rd platoon 59th Chemical Company tasked with finding and removing any potential chemical or biological weapons.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨马沃之战发生在2003年入侵伊拉克期间，美军与伊拉克部队交战并试图清剿该市。美军推进巴格达时绕过了萨马沃，之后由美国第82空降师伞兵负责清剿该市，并得到机械化步兵和装甲部队支援。支援部队包括第1营第41步兵团和第2营第70装甲团；另有第59化学连第3排负责搜寻并清除可能存在的化学或生物武器。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of the Karbala Gap occurred during the 2003 invasion of Iraq. The Karbala Gap is a 20–25-mile wide strip of land with the Euphrates River to the east and Lake Razazah to the west. This strip of land was recognized by Iraqi commanders as a key approach to Baghdad, and was defended by the Medina and Bakhtnisar Divisions of the Iraqi Republican Guard.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡尔巴拉缺口之战发生于2003年入侵伊拉克期间。卡尔巴拉缺口是一条宽20至25英里的地带，东侧是幼发拉底河，西侧是拉扎扎湖。伊拉克指挥官认为这里是进攻巴格达的关键通道，因此部署麦地那师和巴赫特尼萨尔师的共和国卫队守卫。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 2003 Wamena incident (Indonesian: Peristiwa Wamena 2003) involved a sweeping operation and forced relocation of civilians around the town of Wamena by the Indonesian Army and the Indonesian National Police following a raid on an armory. The operations lasted for around two months following the raid, displacing thousands of civilians and resulting in the deaths of around fifty civilians from various causes.

zh.s: 2003年4月4日凌晨，印度尼西亚巴布亚瓦梅纳发生袭击事件，随后安全部队开展大规模清剿行动，造成居民被迫迁离。

en.s: The Siege of Sadr City was a blockade of the Shi'a district of northeastern Baghdad carried out by US and Iraqi government forces in an attempt to destroy the main power base of the insurgent Mahdi Army in Baghdad. The siege began on 4 April 2004 – later dubbed "Black Sunday" – with an uprising against the Coalition Provisional Authority following the government banning of a newspaper published by Muqtada Al-Sadr's Sadrist Movement.

zh.s: 美军与伊拉克政府军封锁巴格达东北部什叶派聚居区萨德尔城，试图摧毁迈赫迪军在巴格达的主要势力基地。围困始于2004年4月4日，这一天后来被称为“黑色星期日”。此前，政府查禁了穆克塔达·萨德尔运动发行的一份报纸，引发反对联军临时管理当局的起义。

en.s: The 2004 National Soccer League Grand Final was held on 4 April 2004 between Parramatta Power and Perth Glory at Parramatta Stadium. en.t: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake hits south of the Mexico-USA border, killing at least two and damaging buildings across the two countries
en.s: The 2010 Baja California earthquake (also known as 2010 Easter earthquake, 2010 Sierra El Mayor earthquake, or 2010 El Mayor–Cucapah earthquake) occurred on April 4 (Easter Sunday) with a moment magnitude of 7.2 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent). The shock originated at 15:40:41 local time (3:40:41 PM PDT) south of Guadalupe Victoria, Baja California, Mexico. The 89-second quake was widely felt throughout northwest Mexico and southern California.

zh.t: 墨西哥下加利福尼亚州地震
zh.s: 2010年下加利福尼亚州地震又称2010年复活节地震、2010年谢拉埃尔马约尔地震或2010年埃尔马约尔—库卡帕地震，发生于4月4日（复活节星期日），矩震级为7.2级，麦加利烈度最高为IX度（剧烈）。地震于当地时间15:40:41（太平洋夏令时间下午3:40:41）发生，震中位于墨西哥下加利福尼亚州瓜达卢佩维多利亚以南。地震持续89秒，墨西哥西北部和加利福尼亚州南部均有广泛震感。

en.s: The 2017 Wisconsin Spring Election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on April 4, 2017. The top of the ballot was the election for state Superintendent of Public Instruction. There was also an uncontested election for Wisconsin Supreme Court, three uncontested elections for Wisconsin Court of Appeals, and several other nonpartisan local and judicial elections. There were also a number of local referendums for school funding.

zh.s: 2017年4月4日，美国威斯康星州举行春季选举，最主要的职位是州公共教育总监。另有一场没有竞争对手的最高法院法官选举、三场没有竞争对手的州上诉法院法官选举，以及多项其他无党派地方公职和法官选举。许多地方也就学校经费举行公投。

en.s: The Khan Shaykhun chemical attack took place on 4 April 2017 on the town of Khan Shaykhun in the Idlib Governorate of Syria. The town was reported to have been struck by an airstrike by government forces followed by massive civilian chemical poisoning. The release of a toxic gas, which included sarin, or a similar substance, killed at least 89 people and injured more than 541, according to the opposition Idlib Health Directorate.

zh.s: 2017年4月4日，叙利亚伊德利卜省汗谢洪镇遭到化学袭击。据报道，政府军先对该镇发动空袭，随后发生大规模平民化学中毒事件。伊德利卜反对派卫生局称，有毒气体中含有沙林或类似物质，造成至少89人死亡、541人以上受伤。

en.s: The 2017 St. Louis mayoral election was held on April 4, 2017, to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. Incumbent Mayor Francis Slay chose not to run for reelection. Slay, who was serving his fourth term as mayor, indicated in March 2016 that he would run for reelection, but announced in April 2016 that he would not run for a fifth term.

zh.s: 圣路易斯于2017年4月4日举行市长选举。时任市长弗朗西斯·斯雷没有竞选连任。他已担任四届市长，2016年3月曾表示会寻求连任，但同年4月宣布不再竞选第五个任期。

en.s: The 2017 North Las Vegas mayoral election was held on April 4, 2017, to elect the mayor of North Las Vegas, Nevada. It saw the re-election of John Jay Lee.

zh.s: 2017年4月4日，内华达州北拉斯维加斯举行市长选举。约翰·杰伊·李成功连任。

en.s: The 2017 Henderson mayoral election was held on April 4, 2017, to elect the mayor of Henderson, Nevada. It saw the election of Democrat Debra March.

zh.t: 2017年内华达州亨德森市长选举
zh.s: 2017年4月4日，内华达州亨德森举行市长选举。民主党人黛布拉·马奇当选。

en.s: Rise of the Renegades (2019) was a professional wrestling supercard event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), which took place on April 4, 2019, at the Melrose Ballroom in Queens, New York City, New York. The event was a television taping for MLW Fusion, with Battle Riot II airing as a live Fusion special the following day.

zh.s: 2019年“叛逆者崛起”是职业摔角大联盟（MLW）制作的大型职业摔角赛事，于4月4日在美国纽约市皇后区梅尔罗斯舞厅举行。赛事为《MLW Fusion》录制节目；翌日的“战斗暴乱第二届”则作为《Fusion》特别节目直播。

en.s: United We Stand was a professional wrestling internet pay-per-view (iPPV) event produced by Impact Wrestling that took place on April 4, 2019 in Rahway, New Jersey. It was the second event in the 2019 Impact Wrestling pay-per-view schedule. Wrestlers from Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) and Lucha Underground – with whom Impact has partnerships with – as well as stars from Major League Wrestling (MLW), Dragon Gate and Wrestle Pro also appeared on the card.

zh.s: “团结屹立”是Impact摔角联盟制作的网络按次付费职业摔角赛事，于2019年4月4日在美国新泽西州拉韦举行，是该联盟2019年按次付费赛程的第二场。除本联盟选手外，与其合作的AAA和地下摔角联盟选手，以及职业摔角大联盟、龙门和Wrestle Pro的明星也有参赛。

en.s: The Western Libya campaign was a military campaign initiated on 4 April 2019 by the Operation Flood of Dignity (Arabic: عملية طوفان الكرامة) of the Libyan National Army (LNA), which represents the Libyan House of Representatives, to capture the western region of Libya and eventually the capital Tripoli held by the United Nations Security Council-recognised Government of National Accord (GNA).

zh.s: 2019年4月4日，代表利比亚国民代表大会的利比亚国民军，以“尊严洪流行动”发起西部战役，试图夺取利比亚西部地区，并最终攻占首都的黎波里。的黎波里当时由联合国安理会认可的民族团结政府控制。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Newport West was held on 4 April 2019, following the death of incumbent Labour Party MP Paul Flynn. Labour candidate Ruth Jones held the seat for the party, albeit with a reduced majority.

zh.s: 2019年4月4日，英国纽波特西选区举行补选，此前工党现任议员保罗·弗林去世。工党候选人露丝·琼斯为工党保住该席位，但多数票减少。

en.s: The Battle of Gharyan, which unfolded from April 2019 to June 2019, was a significant conflict in the ongoing struggle for control in Libya. The opposing forces were the Libyan National Army (LNA), led by General Khalifa Haftar, and the Government of National Accord (GNA), headed by Prime Minister Fayez al-Sarraj.

en.s: The 2020 Tajik Supercup was the 11th Tajik Supercup, an annual Tajik football match played between the winners of the previous season's Tajikistan Higher League and Tajikistan Cup. The match was contested by 2019 League and Cup champions Istiklol, and the league runners-up Khujand. It was held at the Pamir Stadium in Dushanbe on 4 April.

zh.s: 2020年塔吉克斯坦超级杯是第11届该项赛事，由上赛季塔吉克斯坦高级联赛和塔吉克斯坦杯冠军参加。比赛于2020年4月4日在杜尚别的帕米尔体育场举行，由2019年联赛和杯赛双料冠军伊斯蒂克洛尔队对阵联赛亚军胡占德队。

en.s: The parliament of Kosovo held indirect elections for president of Kosovo on 3 and 4 April 2021. The elections successfully concluded after three rounds, with Vjosa Osmani winning 71 votes out of a total possible 120. Three political parties boycotted the vote. Nasuf Bejta, also a member of Guxo, the political party Osmani founded, was the only other candidate who received a vote during any of the other rounds.

zh.s: 2021年4月3日和4日，科索沃议会通过间接投票选举总统。经过三轮投票，维约萨·奥斯马尼取得最多可能120票中的71票，成功当选。三个政党抵制投票。同属奥斯马尼创建的“敢于”党的纳苏夫·贝伊塔，是其他轮次中唯一获得过选票的另一名候选人。

en.s: The Siege of Chernihiv was a military engagement in the city of Chernihiv, in Chernihiv Oblast in the north of Ukraine. It began on 24 February 2022, as part of the northern Ukraine offensive, during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. On 4 April 2022, Ukrainian authorities stated that the Russian military had left Chernihiv Oblast. The city was about 70% destroyed due to the siege.

zh.t: 2023年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2023年4月4日星期二，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。密尔沃基县巡回法院法官珍妮特·普罗塔谢维奇，击败前州最高法院法官丹尼尔·凯利，使该院从保守派多数转为自由派多数。原文在介绍现任法官的姓名“Patience D.”时中断。

en.s: The 2023 Brown County, Wisconsin Executive election took place on April 4, 2023. Incumbent County Executive Troy Streckenbach ran for re-election to a fourth term. He faced no opposition and was re-elected unopposed.

zh.t: 2023年威斯康星州布朗县县长选举
zh.s: 2023年4月4日，美国威斯康星州布朗县举行县长选举。现任县长特洛伊·斯特雷肯巴赫寻求第四个任期，在没有竞争对手的情况下连任。

en.s: The 2023 Denver mayoral election was held on April 4, 2023, to elect the mayor of Denver, Colorado, with a runoff held on June 6. The election was officially nonpartisan and was held concurrently with elections for the Denver City Council, as well as city auditor and city clerk and recorder. Incumbent mayor Michael Hancock was term-limited and could not seek a fourth term in office.

zh.s: 2023年4月4日，美国科罗拉多州丹佛举行市长选举，第二轮决选于6月6日进行。选举正式采取无党派形式，与市议会、市审计官及市书记官兼登记官选举同期举行。现任市长迈克尔·汉考克受任期限制，无法寻求第四个任期。

en.s: The 2023 Wisconsin Spring Election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on April 4, 2023. The featured race at the top of the ticket was for an open seat on the Wisconsin Supreme Court, which became the most expensive judicial election in history. Several other nonpartisan local and judicial offices were also decided on the April 4 ballot, including mayoral elections in some of Wisconsin's larger cities—Green Bay, Madison, and Racine.

zh.s: 2023年4月4日，美国威斯康星州举行春季选举。最受关注的是州最高法院一个开放席位的竞争，按原文记载，这场竞选的费用创下当时法官选举历史纪录。当天也决定多项无党派地方公职和法官职位，包括格林贝、麦迪逊及拉辛等州内较大城市的市长选举。

en.s: The 2023 Chicago aldermanic election took place in two rounds on February 28 and April 4, 2023, to elect 50 alderpersons to the Chicago City Council. Each alderperson represents one of Chicago's 50 wards. The elections are non-partisan and use a two-round system where the top two finishers compete in a second-round runoff if no candidate receives more than 50% of the vote in the first round.

zh.s: 2023年2月28日和4月4日，芝加哥分两轮举行市议员选举，选出市议会50名议员。每位议员代表芝加哥的一个选区。选举不设党派标签，并采用两轮制：如果首轮没有候选人得票超过50%，得票最多的两名候选人将进入第二轮决选。

en.s: The 2023 Los Angeles special election was held on April 4, 2023, with a runoff occurring on June 27, 2023. Voters will elect a candidate in a nonpartisan primary, with runoff elections potentially scheduled. One of the fifteen seats on the Los Angeles City Council was up for election due to the vacancy of one member, councilwoman Nury Martinez of District 6, who resigned in the wake of the 2022 Los Angeles City Council scandal.

zh.s: 2023年4月4日，洛杉矶举行特别选举，第二轮选举于6月27日进行。选民先在不设党派的初选中选出候选人；如有需要，再举行第二轮。洛杉矶市议会15个席位之一因第六选区议员努里·马丁内斯在2022年市议会丑闻后辞职而出缺，因此此次选举将改选该席位。

en.s: The 2023 Colorado Springs mayoral election was held on April 4, 2023, to elect the mayor of Colorado Springs, Colorado, with a runoff scheduled for May 16. Incumbent mayor John Suthers was term-limited and could not seek a third term in office. The election was officially nonpartisan. A wide field of candidates filed to run in the election, including several members of municipal government.

zh.t: 2023年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举
zh.s: 2023年4月4日，科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯举行市长选举，第二轮投票定于5月16日举行。现任市长约翰·萨瑟斯因任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。选举不设党派标签，报名参选者众多，其中包括多名市政府官员。

en.s: Springfield, Missouri held an election for mayor on April 4, 2023. Incumbent mayor Ken McClure faced off against fellow candidate Melanie Bach. McClure was re-elected mayor by a margin of roughly six percentage points, winning 53.18% to Bach’s 46.82%. Springfield mayoral elections are nonpartisan and candidates are not affiliated with a specific party on ballots.

zh.t: 2023年密苏里州斯普林菲尔德市长选举
zh.s: 2023年4月4日，密苏里州斯普林菲尔德举行市长选举。现任市长肯·麦克卢尔对阵候选人梅兰妮·巴赫。麦克卢尔以53.18%对46.82%的得票率、约6个百分点的优势连任。斯普林菲尔德市长选举不设党派，候选人的党派不会列在选票上。

en.s: The 2023 Chicago mayoral election was held on February 28, 2023, to elect the mayor of Chicago, Illinois. With no candidate receiving a majority of votes in the initial round of the election, a runoff election was held on April 4. This two-round election took place alongside other 2023 Chicago elections, including races for City Council, city clerk, city treasurer, and police district councils.

en.s: The 2023 St. Louis aldermanic elections were held in two rounds, with nonpartisan blanket approval voting primaries on March 7 and general elections on April 4. All 14 members of the St. Louis Board of Aldermen and the President of the Board of Aldermen were elected. These were the first elections held after Proposition R (2012) came into effect, reducing the number of alderpersons from 28 to 14.

en.s: The 2023 Chicago elections took place in two rounds on February 28, 2023, and April 4, 2023. Elections were held for Mayor of Chicago, City Clerk of Chicago, City Treasurer of Chicago, all 50 members of the Chicago City Council, and 66 members of the newly created police District Councils. The elections were administered by the Chicago Board of Elections.

en.s: In the southeastern border province of Sistan and Balochistan, an attack on an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) headquarters happened on the night of 4 April 2024. At least 16 Iranian security force members were killed in this attack. The clashes occurred in the towns of Chabahar, Rask and Sarbaz. Jaish ul-Adl, a Sunni armed group, was involved in the attack and lost at least 16 members during the clashes.

zh.s: 2024年4月4日晚，伊朗东南部边境省份锡斯坦-俾路支斯坦的一处伊斯兰革命卫队总部遭袭，至少16名伊朗安全人员死亡。冲突发生在恰巴哈尔、拉斯克和萨尔巴兹。参与袭击的逊尼派武装“正义军”也在交火中损失至少16名成员。

en.s: The PFL 1 mixed martial arts event for the 2024 season of the Professional Fighters League was held on April 4, 2024, at the Boeing Center at Tech Port in San Antonio, Texas, United States. This marked the first regular-season event of the tournament and included fights in the Women's Flyweight and Heavyweight divisions.

zh.s: 2024赛季职业格斗联盟PFL 1综合格斗赛事，于4月4日在美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥科技港波音中心举行。这是当季首场常规赛，安排女子蝇量级及重量级比赛。

en.s: The Battle of Chasiv Yar is a military engagement in the Russo-Ukrainian war between the Russian Armed Forces and the Armed Forces of Ukraine for control of the city of Chasiv Yar and surrounding villages. The battle began on 4 April 2024 with the first direct assault on the city by Russian forces, and has thus far seen the capture of the district east of a canal passing through the city, the crossing of the canal, and the claimed capture of the city as of early August 2025.

zh.s: 恰西夫亚尔之战是俄乌战争中的一场军事交战，交战双方为俄罗斯武装部队和乌克兰武装部队，争夺恰西夫亚尔市及周边村庄的控制权。2024年4月4日，俄军首次直接进攻该市，战斗由此开始。截至2025年8月初，俄军已占领市内运河以东地区并越过运河，且宣称已控制该市。
